svg.title: VAREK Enterprise on AWS: typical deployment
svg.desc: A VAREK Enterprise EC2 instance in a private subnet of the customer's VPC. The instance role allows license-manager:CheckoutLicense. Outbound HTTPS reaches AWS License Manager, AWS Systems Manager and the Amazon Linux repositories in Amazon S3 through VPC endpoints or a NAT gateway. The supervised agent reaches only the destinations its policy allows. An optional off-host anchor receives signed checkpoints over SSH. AWS Backup snapshots the volume.
svg.text: Region (any Region the listing is offered in)
Security group: no inbound rules, or SSH 22 from an admin CIDR
VAREK Enterprise AMI on Amazon EC2
Amazon Linux 2023, x86_64, t3.medium or larger, IMDSv2
decides each file, network and exec action before it runs
enable EBS encryption at launch (AWS KMS)
